name: Fiberon PA12-CF10 @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.6 nozzle
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 10 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 13 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
Warp-Free nylon: keep build plate AND ambient air below 50 C (open chamber doors); no enclosure. All-metal hotend + hardened/ruby nozzle (brass nozzle life ~9 h per TDS). Very hygroscopic: print from a heated dryer, store <20% RH. TDS chamber temperature: 'Room Temp.' Moisture-condition parts after annealing. Low moisture absorption vs PA6. Black; 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools. Fan OFF. Support: PolySupport for PA12 or PolyDissolve S1.
Source: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0548/7299/7945/files/TDS_FIBERON_PA12-CF10_V1.1_EN.pdf?v=1740427088
